name: Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University
benefit:
- **Master’s degree students:** ₹5,000/- per month for 2 years.  - **Ph.D. degree students:** ₹5,000/- per month for 3 years.
> **Note:** The University shall annually award four fellowships in each of the concerned faculties for both Master&#39;s well as Doctorate degree programmes.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must be enrolled in a Master’s or Ph.D. program at Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University (SDAU). - The applicant must have secured a first-class or its equivalent OGPA in the qualifying undergraduate or postgraduate examination from a State Agricultural University in Gujarat. - The applicant must be 28 years of age or below at the time of application. - The applicant must maintain a minimum OGPA of 7.5 and must not receive an “F” (Fail) or “I” (Incomplete) grade during the course of study.
